hooks.text: 不是逐张出牌，而是一次编排整手符文，让触发顺序直接决定连锁伤害
hooks.excerpt: Unlike traditional card games, where you play one card at a time, in Runeveil, you play the whole hand, where the sequence of the runes is the most important.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 开战前即可看见奖励，把当前战斗选择提前纳入终局牌组规划
hooks.excerpt: You can see your fight rewards from the beginning. Start your strategy to build the ultimate deck from the start!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 符文叠加遗物、药水与附魔，堆乘区甚至制造无限循环
hooks.excerpt: Collect ancient Artifacts , use magical Potions , and apply Enchantments to your runes. Stack multipliers, trigger infinite loops, and create a build so powerful that even the Arena Kings tremble.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分玩家认为可重玩性不足。
后两名法师体验不如前两名。

excerpts.excerpt: First two mages were fun, didn't enjoy the second two.

opinions.text: 中途混合不同牌组类型增加构筑复杂度。

excerpts.excerpt: the ability to mix deck types in the middle of a run adds a neat complexity
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 职业差异与各职业内部协同都很丰富。

excerpts.excerpt: solid variety between classes and a variety of synergies within each class to build around
